name: repetition
note: A DERIVED LEMMA, not the rule (plan 75.4 (2); printed 'repetition (a forced cycle: the threefold rule is reachable)'): a position of the line or the game repeated ONCE, every reply of the cycle read, is taken as evidence that the rule's draw (the third occurrence: 'draw by repetition') is reachable, and when we are behind closes as a draw claim worth minus the balance (Ideas.Forcing.repetition_level: the value arithmetic only). Lean proves the strict form generically (Ideas.Game.forced_cycle_threefold: with their replies along the cycle their only moves and the identity a congruence of the game, replaying the cycle reaches the third occurrence); the chase checks neither hypothesis (it reads every reply, it does not require one) and the congruence is not proved for the chess kernel, so the claim is a conjecture.
